description: Manage an EXISTING Autopilot enrollment for a household employee. Actions: `pause` (stop new generation — an already-scheduled run still fires unless voided from the payroll page), `resume` (re-checks eligibility + clears the failure counter), `skip` (skip the next period; with through_date, skip every period up to that date for a vacation), `disable` (turn Autopilot off — soft-deleted so the ledger + ACH authorization are retained; the employee can re-enroll in-app). Turning Autopilot ON is NOT available here — it captures a standing recurring ACH authorization that must be done by the employer in the app. Requires a Plus/Professional key. Confirm the action with the user before calling.

action.description: What to do: pause | resume | skip | disable

employee_id.description: Employee UUID whose enrollment to manage

through_date.description: skip only: skip every upcoming period up to this date (YYYY-MM-DD) for a multi-week vacation

name: manage_autopilot
